g.text: Assistive Device Redistribution Platform • PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS Spatial Engine • 11 Normalized Tables (3NF)
PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS Engine Features (DBMS Viva Focus)
• Fast Nearest-Neighbor distance queries: ST_DWithin(d.geometry, n.geometry, radius_meters)
• trg_device_set_geometry: Automatically converts lat/lng to ST_MakePoint on INSERT/UPDATE
• trg_need_set_geometry: Auto-populates PostGIS geometry point for seeker demands
• trg_audit_device_status: Automatically appends immutable event into audit_log on status transition
Validates that device has verdict = 'SAFE' and expires_at > now() before enabling matching
• vw_district_aggregate: Aggregate view grouping available vs. delivered devices by category
• Native PostgreSQL tsvector (description_tsv) for BM25 semantic full-text search
• Schema conforms strictly to Third Normal Form (3NF).
• No transitive or partial dependencies across tables.
• PostGIS geometry points are kept 100% in sync with
ORM float coordinates via database triggers.
